title: Starting to write songs in Chicago and losing them to copyists
summary: Punch started writing songs in Chicago, writing notes down after working them out on his horn. Other players learned Punch's songs by ear and recorded them; he never copyrighted them and could do nothing.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
